text_block_list.text:
While visiting a cafe during my break, I 
noticed ingredients for hot chocolate 
lined up on the counter.

"Come to think of it, today is Valentine's 
Day. I might as well buy some, I thought, 
but just as I reached out—"

"Come to think of it, Tanino Gimlet's 
always the one treating me to things."
However—

When I returned to the academy, Tanino 
Gimlet was nowhere to be found.

After searching for a while, I noticed a 
letter left on the desk, almost as if in 
place of what I was looking for.

text_block_list.name: Letter
text_block_list.text:
"I ask of you: What walks on four legs in 
the morning, two legs at noon, and six 
legs in the evening?"

text_block_list.name: Letter
text_block_list.text:
“If you have found your answer, then you 
should go to the place that symbolizes 
it.”

text_block_list.name: Letter
text_block_list.text:
"P.S. If you recall our beginning, you 
will naturally find the answer."

Reading the letter, thinking, and 
reflecting. What came to mind was—

I believe there was a famous riddle: 'What 
walks on four legs in the morning, two 
legs at noon, and three legs in the 
evening?'—

Unlike the legend, it says 'six legs at 
night.' Then the answer likely isn't the 
same as the legend either.
choice_data_list:
(If there's anything to be gleaned from 
this...)

text_block_list.text:
I thought about it for a while, but 
nothing particularly good came to mind.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text: —Time's up.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
However... knowing you, you have given 
this plenty of thought.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Today is a day for sharing benevolence. 
Shall I treat you to a refreshing drink as 
a reward for your hard work?

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text: ...What is it?
choice_data_list: Let me be the one to treat you today.
Please, let me treat you today.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text: What... you?

I nodded, and began making hot chocolate 
with the ingredients I had prepared.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text: ...Heh.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text: Haha!! Ahaha!! Ahaaaaaaaaaahahahaha!!!!

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
What sweetness! Such a flavor overflowing 
with benevolence! Truly a cup worthy of 
this very day!!!!

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Brava, meravigliosa, magnifica, 
fantastica—

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
I shall shower you in endless praise!! For 
as long as you desire, until your heart is 
content!!!

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Come, take up your cup as well! Let us 
drink this sweet nectar down together to 
the last drop!!!

After that, the two of us enjoyed the hot 
chocolate together. She seemed quite 
pleased with the unexpected return gift.

As I pondered, something suddenly caught 
my curiosity. It was the phrase, "Our 
Beginning."

I first met her at a dining bar. If 
there's a hint to be found in that 
scenery...
—I get it! Could 'six legs' mean...!

Having been struck by an idea, I decided 
to head straight to that location.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text: ...Hooh, so you've come.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Judging by your expression, it seems you 
found your answer.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text: ...Heh. Haha, hahahahaha—

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Ahahaha!! What brilliant insight and 
discernment!!! That is truly the optimal 
solution!!!!

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
As an Umamusume, when I was young, I used 
to walk on two hands and two feet.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Right now, running across the ground on 
two legs—and then.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
And just like this, I'm sharing a drink 
with you.

Two drinks were placed between Tanino 
Gimlet and me. One for her, and one for 
myself.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
My two legs, your two legs, and two cups. 
Together, it's as if we form "six legs."

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Therefore, the answer is none other 
than—!! I, who share this cup with you!! 
Namely, "Gimlet" itself!!!!

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text: ...Heh, I am satisfied.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Our wills have aligned. And on this day of 
all days, one that symbolizes affection.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
This is nothing short of fate. Don't you 
agree, my peerless one?

I felt a little bashful, but today is 
Valentine's Day. It's the perfect occasion 
to reaffirm our bond.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text: ...Heh, good answer.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text: Then let it begin. Tonight's banquet.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
—This is a specially prepared pitch-black 
nectar. Take your time... savor it fully, 
and enjoy.
